Screen checkConfirm in Vanderbilt's Oracle or UKG during a recorded demo: the Individual Compensation quick action name; plan names (Lump sum payment, Bonus, staff supplements); the Net, Amount, Process separately, and Ongoing field labels; that a regular HCM (not a super-user) sees Our Workforce and this quick action.

1 · Intro

When to use it.

A staff supplement pays someone extra for extra duties over a period, such as acting in a vacant leadership role at $2,000 a month until the backfill. It is recurring, so it keeps paying each payroll until its end date.

Use this whenSomeone takes on extra duties for a period of time.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Which supplement (from the award compensation guide)
Plan (code)Use for
Administrative Supplement (ADS)Acting or interim in an administrative vacancy while a search runs. Expected less than a year.
Interim Appointment Supplement (INTERIM)Same situation, expected 12 months or more.
Temporary Supplement (TEMPSUP)Short-term additional responsibilities.
Not forFaculty, post-docs, students, or temps. Faculty have their own supplements.

Watch-outs

  • Ongoing supplements keep paying until someone ends them. Set a reminder.
  • Guide dated 01/17/2023. Confirm current plan names with finance.

HCM Academy job aid · Compensation Management

Add a staff supplement

Use when: Someone takes on extra duties for a period of time. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Open Individual Compensation for the employee.
  2. Click Add, then choose Add staff supplement.
  3. Plan: choose the supplement type.
  4. Enter the amount.
  5. Leave Process separately set to Yes.
  6. Start date: the first day of the target payroll month (for example, Nov 1).
  7. Set the end date.
    • Unknown end: leave Ongoing on.
    • Known end: turn Ongoing off and enter the end date (for example, Dec 31).
  8. Click Save and confirm every field.
  9. Click Continue for comments or attachments, then Submit.
